metadata.title: Neon Beats Factory (NBF) — Bass Boosted Festival Drop: Stay For The Afterglow
metadata.description:
Turn the lights down and the sub up—“Stay For The Afterglow” from Neon Beats Factory (NBF) is a neon-soaked wave of momentum made for midnight drives, warehouse nights, and festival chaos. Expect euphoric energy, irresistible hooks, and that peak-time glow that makes you want to stay just one track longer.

From razor-sharp synth stabs to punchy low-end and glossy melodic layers, this one’s engineered for maximum replay. Watch it all unfold in a stunning 60 FPS visualizer—clean, vibrant, and perfectly synced to the rhythm so every drop hits harder and every build feels cinematic.
